name: Vile Fin Scale
summary: Vile Fin Scale comes from murloc tribes prowling Tirisfal’s northern coasts and waterways. In Brill, the Royal Apothecary Society studies these samples as it works on a plague meant to strike the living and the Scourge.

sections.title: Apothecary Reagents
sections.body: The Royal Apothecary Society seeks a blight that can spread through the living and the Scourge. Simple toxins are easy to brew, but an infectious disease needs properties that help it pass from one population to another. In Brill, Apothecary Johaan studies Vile Fin scales for their natural resilience and mucous coatings. He hopes these traits can help stabilize his experimental contagions and carry them onward.

sections.title: The Coastline Menace
sections.body: The Vile Fin tribe inhabits Tirisfal Glades’ northern shores and western shallows, where its members threaten travelers and press into Forsaken territory. Gathering their scales helps keep the feral murloc populations in check and supplies Johaan’s laboratory with fresh organic material for tests in biological warfare.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Johaan want these scales?
aliases: what does johaan do with scales
faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan studies Vile Fin scales for the Royal Apothecary Society’s work on a new plague. Ordinary poisons lack the power to spread, so he examines the scales’ natural properties for help carrying his experiments from one population to another.

faq.q: Where can Vile Fin murlocs be found?
faq.answer: Vile Fin murlocs inhabit Tirisfal Glades’ coasts, especially the northern shoreline and western waters beside Brightwater Lake and the sea.

faq.q: What makes the New Plague project important to the Forsaken?
faq.answer: The Forsaken seek a weapon against their bitter rivals: the mindless Scourge and the living races who see them as monsters. Johaan’s work in Brill is an early effort toward that kingdom-wide aim.

faq.q: Which specific creatures carry these scales?
faq.answer: Vile Fin Minor Oracles, Muckdwellers, and Puddlejumpers of the Vile Fin tribe in Tirisfal carry these scales.

angles.text: As an undead, each Vile Fin scale you gather aids the Royal Apothecary Society’s duty to develop a weapon for Forsaken survival against the living and the Scourge.
As Horde, you help secure Tirisfal Glades’ outskirts for messengers and travelers when you clear aggressive coastal murloc settlements.
